newsitem.title: USA: Merchants Group says Mutual withdraws plan.
newsitem.headline: Merchants Group says Mutual withdraws plan.

text.p: Merchants Group Inc said Monday that Merchants Mutual Insurance Co has withdrawn an application to convert from a mutual to a stock corporation.
Due to the "significant improvement" in Mutual's financial condition, Merchants Group said in a release Monday that the company decided to withdraw its application.
Merchants Group and Mutual are now discussing alternatives to a stock conversion, including a pooling of their insurance operations, the company added.
Merchants Mutual Insurance Co owns about eight percent of Merchants Group's stock, and the two companies jointly market their insurance products, an executive at Merchants Group said.
